verdict.rationale: Grafana has a public pricing page (grafana.com/pricing) describing a self-serve free tier with "No charges ever," and a community user calls Grafana Cloud cheap, so some pricing is published without involving sales. However, the evidence never shows per-signal rates for metrics, logs, traces or profiles, nor any way to forecast spend from them. Adaptive Telemetry's cost reduction is a separate feature and is not credited here. Missing for 10: published per-signal unit prices (metrics/logs/traces/profiles), paid-tier pricing details, a cost estimator or calculator, and independent confirmation that costs can be predicted without sales contact.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can predict costs from transparent published per-signal pricing without talking to sales

citations.quote: Perfect for personal projects, exploring new ideas, and early-stage startups. No charges ever.
Cost is the big selling point of Grafana Cloud: far cheaper than most competitors and good enough.
